knock.definitionEn: To strike something, especially a door, with a firm, sharp sound, or to make such a sound.
knock.definitionCn: v. 敲；击；碰撞；发出敲击声；n. 敲；敲击声；（尤指汽车引擎的）爆震声；（用于表示）批评，非议

shake.definitionEn: To move something quickly back and forth or up and down; or to tremble involuntarily.
shake.definitionCn: v. 摇动；颤抖；握手；动摇；n. 摇动；震动；奶昔；（戏剧）谢幕时的欢呼

click.definitionEn: A short, sharp sound, or the action of making such a sound, often associated with pressing a button or a mouse.
click.definitionCn: n. 咔哒声；按键声；v. 发出咔哒声；点击

pour.definitionEn: To cause a liquid to flow in a stream from a container.
pour.definitionCn: v. 倒；倾泻；（雨等）倾盆而下；（目光、话语等）倾注；（人群）涌来

pack.definitionEn: A group of animals, especially wolves, that hunt together; or to put things into a container to be carried or stored.
pack.definitionCn: n. （尤指狼的）一群；背包；包装；v. 包装；打包；塞满；（军队）驻扎

slice.definitionCn: n. 片；切片；一份；（计算机）切片；（高尔夫球）削球；（桥牌）切牌；（计算机）切片；v. 切成片；切下；切碎；（计算机）切片

bend.definitionEn: To curve or cause to curve; to turn or cause to turn.
bend.definitionCn: v. 弯曲；使弯曲；转弯；使转向；屈服；屈从； n. 弯曲；弯；转弯处；曲折

load.definitionEn: A large quantity of something that is carried or transported, or the act of putting a large quantity of something onto a vehicle or into a container.
load.definitionCn: n. 负荷；装载量；（计算机）加载；（枪）弹药；（诗）负担；（俚）毒品；v. 装载；使充满；使负担重；（计算机）加载；（枪）装填

grab.definitionEn: To take or seize something suddenly and roughly, or to take an opportunity.
grab.definitionCn: v. 抓住；夺取；急忙赶去；n. 抓；夺；（尤指）一次（抓住或夺取）

voucher.definitionEn: A document or a code that can be exchanged for a discount or a specific product or service.
voucher.definitionCn: n. 代金券；凭证；（用于证明付款或批准的）证明文件

category.definitionEn: A class or division of people or things regarded as having particular shared characteristics.
category.definitionCn: n. 类别；范畴；种类；（尤指）分类

four.definitionEn: The number that is one more than three; equivalent to the product of two and two.

five.definitionEn: The number that is one more than four; 5.

two.definitionEn: The number that is one more than one; the second in a counting sequence.

dog.definitionEn: A domesticated carnivorous mammal that typically has a long snout, an acute sense of smell, and a barking, howling, or whining voice.
dog.definitionCn: n. 狗；犬；（用于贬称）卑鄙的人；（用于贬称）妓女

three.definitionEn: The number that is one more than two; 3.

reservation.definitionEn: An arrangement to have something (like a table or seat) held for your use at a particular time.
reservation.definitionCn: n. 预订；保留；预约；（土地的）保留区；疑虑；顾虑

avocado.definitionEn: A fruit with a large seed, a soft green flesh, and a dark green skin, often eaten as food.

cocktail.definitionEn: A mixed alcoholic drink, often containing fruit juice, flavorings, and other ingredients.
cocktail.definitionCn: n. 鸡尾酒；混合物；混合锦标赛

mint.definitionEn: A plant with aromatic leaves, often used for flavoring food and drinks, or a place where money is made.
mint.definitionCn: n. 薄荷；唇形科植物；制造厂；印钞厂；巨款；adj. 崭新的；完美的；v. 铸造（钱币）；制造；虚构

delivery.definitionEn: The act of bringing goods or letters to a place or person, or the process of giving birth.
delivery.definitionCn: n. 递送；交付；分娩；演讲；表达方式

side.definitionEn: A position to the left or right of a person or thing, or one of the surfaces forming the outer boundary of an object.
side.definitionCn: n. 旁边；侧面；一边；方面；面；坡；（家庭）一方；（比赛）一方；（食物）配菜；（枪的）侧面；（汽车的）座位；（戏剧的）侧幕；（计算机）侧边；v. 位于…的旁边；与…并列；（在争论或比赛中）支持；adj. 侧面的；附属的；次要的；（食物）配用的

sushi.definitionEn: A Japanese dish consisting of small balls or rolls of vinegar-flavored cold cooked rice, typically with a topping of raw fish or seafood.

ramen.definitionEn: A Japanese noodle soup dish consisting of Chinese-style wheat noodles served in a meat or fish-based broth, often flavored with soy sauce or miso, and topped with ingredients such as sliced pork, nori, menma, and scallions.

trail marker.definitionEn: A sign or object placed along a path or route to indicate the way, especially for hikers or travelers.
trail marker.definitionCn: n. 路径标记；路标；指示物（用于指示方向，尤指供徒步旅行者或旅人使用）

backpacking.definitionEn: The activity of traveling for pleasure with a rucksack, especially in the countryside or in foreign countries.
backpacking.definitionCn: n. 背包旅行；徒步旅行

gps.definitionEn: A system that uses satellites to determine the exact position of a device on Earth.
gps.definitionCn: n. 全球定位系统；卫星导航系统

paddle.definitionEn: A short oar used for rowing a small boat, or to hit something lightly.
paddle.definitionCn: n. 桨；船桨；（球拍、网拍等）拍板；（尤指用于打屁股的）拍子；（尤指用于划船的）短桨；v. 用桨划（船）；用手（或脚）划水；拍打；拍（某人）的屁股

paddleboard.definitionEn: A board, similar to a surfboard, that you stand on to move through water using a paddle.
paddleboard.definitionCn: n. 桨板；冲浪板；v. 玩桨板；用桨划行

raft.definitionEn: A flat structure, often made of logs or inflatable material, used for floating on water, or the act of traveling on such a structure.
raft.definitionCn: n. 木筏；救生筏；筏子；(用充气材料制成的)漂浮设备；v. 用木筏运输；乘筏漂流

innertube.definitionEn: A flexible, inflatable rubber tube that is placed inside the tire of a wheel, especially on a bicycle or car, to hold air.

canoe.definitionEn: A lightweight, narrow boat, pointed at both ends and open on top, propelled by one or more paddlers facing the stern.
canoe.definitionCn: n. 独木舟，皮划艇；v. 用独木舟或皮划艇运送；乘独木舟航行

wetsuit.definitionEn: A close-fitting garment made of rubber or neoprene, worn by surfers, divers, and others to keep warm in the water.
wetsuit.definitionCn: n. 潜水服；冲浪服；湿衣

pfd.definitionEn: Abbreviation for Personal Flotation Device, a type of life jacket worn for safety, especially on boats.
pfd.definitionCn: abbr. 个人漂浮装置；救生衣；救生背心

waypoint.definitionEn: A point on a route or journey that is used for navigation or as a reference.
waypoint.definitionCn: n. 航点；路标；（计算机）检查点

snowshoe.definitionEn: A large, flat frame worn on the foot to walk on deep snow without sinking.
snowshoe.definitionCn: n. 雪鞋；雪地鞋；(尤指)宽大的雪地鞋以防陷进雪中 v. 穿雪鞋行走

toboggan.definitionEn: A long, flat-bottomed sled, often curved up at the front, used for sliding down snow-covered hills; to slide down a hill on such a sled.
toboggan.definitionCn: n. 雪橇，雪橇板；v. 乘雪橇滑下

sledding.definitionEn: The activity of riding down a snow-covered hill on a sled.

chairlift.definitionEn: A type of transport system that carries people up a mountain or hill in chairs attached to a moving cable.

sled.definitionEn: A vehicle, often with runners, used for sliding over snow or ice, or a person who rides on a sled.
sled.definitionCn: n. 雪橇；滑橇；（尤指）雪橇运动；（坐在雪橇上）滑行的人；v. 乘坐雪橇；驾驶雪橇

tubing.definitionEn: A long, hollow cylinder, often made of flexible material, used for conveying fluids or for other purposes.
tubing.definitionCn: n. 管子；管道；软管；管状物；（尤指）油管；（用于输送液体等的）管状物；（滑雪或漂流的）管状雪橇；管状物制作

snorkel.definitionEn: A breathing tube used for swimming just below the surface of the water, allowing you to see underwater without lifting your head.
snorkel.definitionCn: n. 潜水通气管；潜水镜；v. 使用潜水通气管游泳

gondola.definitionEn: A long, narrow boat with a flat bottom, traditionally used in Venice, Italy.
gondola.definitionCn: n. 贡多拉（威尼斯传统长而窄的平底船）；缆车吊箱；（超市、商店的）货架

life jacket.definitionEn: A buoyant vest worn to keep a person afloat in water.

ski pass.definitionEn: A ticket or card that allows a person to use ski lifts and access ski slopes at a resort.
ski pass.definitionCn: n. 滑雪通行证；滑雪票

goggles.definitionEn: A pair of protective glasses worn to prevent injury to the eyes.
goggles.definitionCn: n. 护目镜；（尤指）防护眼镜

mountain bike.definitionEn: A bicycle designed for off-road cycling, typically with knobby tires, a sturdy frame, and suspension.
mountain bike.definitionCn: n. 山地自行车；越野自行车

rock climbing.definitionEn: The sport or activity of climbing up steep rock faces.

road bike.definitionEn: A lightweight bicycle designed for riding on paved surfaces, typically with drop handlebars and narrow tires.

lift ticket.definitionEn: A ticket that allows a person to use a ski lift or other similar transportation at a ski resort.
lift ticket.definitionCn: n. 滑雪缆车票；（滑雪场）缆车票

bouldering.definitionEn: The sport of climbing on large rocks or artificial walls without the use of ropes or harnesses, typically over a short distance.
bouldering.definitionCn: n. 抱石运动；攀岩运动（不使用绳索，通常在短距离内攀爬大石头或人造墙）

belay.definitionEn: To secure a climber or a person by means of a rope, often by wrapping the rope around a fixed object or person.
belay.definitionCn: v. 保护；用绳索固定（攀登者）；（航海）用绳索系住

harness.definitionEn: A set of straps and fittings used to control an animal, especially a horse, or to attach something to a person or object.
harness.definitionCn: n. 马具，挽具；（用于固定或控制某物的）挽具，吊带；v. 给（马）套上挽具；利用，驾驭（自然力等）

rappel.definitionEn: To descend a steep cliff or rock face by using a rope coiled around the body and passed through the legs.

crampon.definitionEn: A metal spike or frame with spikes worn on the sole of a boot to prevent slipping on ice or rock.
crampon.definitionCn: n. 防滑钉鞋；冰爪；爬山鞋底的防滑齿

blizzard.definitionEn: A severe snowstorm with high winds and low visibility.

frostbite.definitionEn: Damage to skin and tissue caused by extreme cold.

trail running.definitionEn: A sport or recreational activity of running on natural paths or unpaved trails, often in forests or mountains.

whiteout.definitionEn: A condition of complete loss of visibility due to snow or fog, or a type of correction fluid used to cover errors.
whiteout.definitionCn: n. 暴风雪；（尤指）雪盲；（打字、书写错误的）修正液；v. 使（能见度）完全丧失；用修正液涂盖

heatstroke.definitionEn: A serious medical condition caused by prolonged exposure to high temperatures, leading to a failure of the body's temperature regulation system.
heatstroke.definitionCn: n. 中暑；热射病；热衰竭

sunburn.definitionEn: A reddening and soreness of the skin caused by overexposure to the sun.
sunburn.definitionCn: n. 晒伤；晒斑；v. 晒伤

bmx.definitionEn: A type of bicycle designed for racing or performing stunts, characterized by small wheels and a lightweight frame.
bmx.definitionCn: n. 小轮车；越野自行车（用于比赛或特技表演）

carabiner.definitionEn: A metal loop with a sprung gate, used to quickly and reversibly connect components, most commonly in safety-critical systems such as rock climbing.
carabiner.definitionCn: n. 登山扣；安全扣；卡宾枪

air quality.definitionEn: The condition of the air around us, especially regarding its purity and suitability for breathing.
air quality.definitionCn: n. 空气质量；空气品质

drought.definitionEn: A long period of unusually dry weather when there is not enough rain.
drought.definitionCn: n. 干旱；旱灾；（尤指）长期缺雨期

evacuation.definitionEn: The act of emptying a place or area of its occupants or contents, often for safety reasons.
evacuation.definitionCn: n. 撤离；疏散；排空；清空

forest fire.definitionEn: A large, destructive fire that spreads quickly through a forest or other area with many trees.

flash flood.definitionEn: A sudden and severe flood that occurs very quickly, often after heavy rain in a mountainous area or a dry region.
flash flood.definitionCn: n. 山洪暴发；突发洪水

wildfire.definitionEn: A large, destructive fire that spreads quickly over a natural area like a forest.

aqi.definitionEn: A measure of air pollution levels, indicating how clean or polluted the air is and what associated health effects might be a concern.
aqi.definitionCn: n. 空气质量指数；空气污染指数

hypothermia.definitionEn: A dangerous condition where the body loses heat faster than it can produce it, causing a dangerously low body temperature.

sleet.definitionEn: Rain that freezes into small pellets of ice before hitting the ground, or a storm with this type of precipitation.
sleet.definitionCn: n. 雨夹雪；冰雹；霰；v. 下雨夹雪

hail.definitionEn: To greet someone enthusiastically or call out to them to get their attention; also, to fall as ice pellets from the sky.
hail.definitionCn: v. 招呼；喊；致敬；雹子落下；n. 冰雹；雹子；（表示赞扬的）欢呼；（表示赞扬的）喝彩

thunderstorm.definitionEn: A storm characterized by thunder and lightning, usually accompanied by heavy rain or hail.

tornado.definitionEn: A violently rotating column of air that is in contact with both the surface of the earth and a cumulonimbus cloud or, in rare cases, the base of a cumulus cloud.

slushy.definitionEn: Resembling or consisting of slush, which is partly melted snow or ice.
slushy.definitionCn: adj. 泥泞的；雪水样的；（感情）伤感的；（文字、艺术等）过于伤感的

camper.definitionEn: A person who spends their vacation or holiday living in a tent or a camper van.
camper.definitionCn: n. 露营者；野营者；野营车；旅行拖车

bear spray.definitionEn: A canister of pepper spray used to deter aggressive bears.
bear spray.definitionCn: n. 熊喷雾；防熊喷雾剂

motorhome.definitionEn: A large vehicle that is equipped for living in, with a bed, kitchen, and bathroom, and is used for travel.

bear bag.definitionEn: A bag designed to be carried by a bear, typically used in wildlife research to study animal behavior or diet.
bear bag.definitionCn: n. 熊袋；用于研究熊的食物或行为的袋子

mosquito.definitionEn: A small flying insect that bites people and animals, often spreading diseases.

icy.definitionEn: Covered with ice, or very cold, like ice.
icy.definitionCn: adj. 冰冷的；结冰的；冰冻的；冷淡的；冷漠的

overcast.definitionEn: Covered with clouds; dark and gloomy.
overcast.definitionCn: adj. 阴天的；黑暗的；忧郁的

bear canister.definitionEn: A portable, rigid container designed to protect food and scented items from bears, typically used by campers and hikers.
bear canister.definitionCn: n. 熊罐；防熊食物罐；防熊容器（一种便携式硬质容器，用于保护食物和有气味的物品不被熊接触，通常由露营者和徒步旅行者使用）

rv.definitionEn: A recreational vehicle, a type of motorhome or trailer used for camping and travel.

sunscreen.definitionEn: A lotion, spray, or cream applied to the skin to protect it from the harmful effects of the sun's rays.

mosquito repellent.definitionEn: A substance or device used to keep mosquitoes away from people or animals.
mosquito repellent.definitionCn: n. 驱蚊剂；驱蚊液；驱蚊器

bug bite.definitionEn: A mark or irritation on the skin caused by an insect or other small creature piercing it to feed.
bug bite.definitionCn: n. 虫咬；咬伤；蚊虫叮咬处

poison oak.definitionEn: A North American plant with lobed leaves that resembles oak leaves, known for causing an itchy rash upon contact.
poison oak.definitionCn: n. 毒橡树；毒藤（一种北美植物，叶子有裂片，形似橡树叶，接触后会引起瘙痒性皮疹）

tick.definitionEn: A small arachnid that attaches itself to the skin of animals and humans to feed on blood; also, the sound a clock makes.
tick.definitionCn: n. 蜱虫；虱子；滴答声；（枪）扳机；（表示同意或选择的）勾号；v. 滴答作响；发出滴答声；给...打勾；（使）触发

moose.definitionEn: A very large animal belonging to the deer family, with long legs and a broad, flat-tipped nose, found in North America and northern Europe and Asia.

spf.definitionEn: Abbreviation for Sun Protection Factor, a measure of how much a sunscreen protects the skin from the sun's ultraviolet rays.
spf.definitionCn: n. 防晒系数；防晒指数

poison ivy.definitionEn: A plant with leaves that cause an itchy rash when touched.

bounce.definitionEn: (Of a check or payment) be returned by a bank when there are insufficient funds; to rebound off a surface.
bounce.definitionCn: （支票/付款）退票，无法兑现；（球等）弹起，反弹。
